**The NAS message container wins over the initial message**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM common procedures / Security mode control procedure |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 52s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.4.2.4 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 names the IE "Replayed NAS message container"; "NAS message container" by V15.7.0, the sentence otherwise unchanged through V19.8.0)
- TS 33.501 6.4.6 step 4 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has the complete message resent only after a failed hash check ("the AMF shall treat this as the initial NAS message to respond to"); the NAS Container, and "The AMF shall use the complete initial NAS message that is in the NAS container as the message to respond to", by V15.20.0 and unchanged through V19.7.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-INITIAL-MSG-CONTAINER-WINS.md).
